pictures.name: VS1-Hill-Road
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A winding dirt road through green and gold terraced hills of first-century Judea, olive trees and stone walls. In the middle, a young woman of about sixteen with olive skin, dark hair under a simple deep blue headscarf, a plain undyed wool dress, walks quickly uphill with a small cloth bundle over her shoulder, her blue headscarf lifting in the breeze, face eager and bright. A small stone village on the hilltop ahead. Morning gold light, deep blue shadows in the valleys. Hurry, hope, joy. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: VS2-The-Doorway
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The arched doorway of a stone house in a hill village. a young woman of about sixteen with olive skin, dark hair under a simple deep blue headscarf, a plain undyed wool dress, steps through the doorway with arms opening in greeting. Inside, an older woman, well past the usual age for a first child, visibly pregnant, with silver-streaked hair under a cream linen headscarf, a warm lined face, in a rust-colored dress, turns from her clay oven, one hand flying to her rounded belly in surprise, eyes wide with joy. Gold sunlight pours in through the door, deep blue shadows inside. The two women in the middle. Surprise, delight, wonder. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside the stone house, an older woman, well past the usual age for a first child, visibly pregnant, with silver-streaked hair under a cream linen headscarf, a warm lined face, in a rust-colored dress, holds both hands of a young woman of about sixteen with olive skin, dark hair under a simple deep blue headscarf, a plain undyed wool dress, and cries out with joy, her face lit up, tears in her eyes. Mary listens, moved and humble. A clay lamp and woven baskets behind them. Warm gold light around the two women, deep blue shadows. The two women’s joined hands in the middle. Blessing, joy, kinship. pictures.name: VS5-Today-Rosary
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A modern living room at evening, painted in the same sacred oil style: a grandmother with silver hair and her adult granddaughter sit side by side on a sofa, each holding a simple wooden-bead rosary, lips moving, eyes half-closed. A small framed painting of Mary visiting Elizabeth on the wall, a candle on a side table. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue window light. The two women and the rosaries in the middle. Gentle, steady, close. No text, no letters, no logos.
